name: [ 🎃 ] Winx - The Fairy Guardians
desc:
⭐ Welcome to Winx – The Fairy Guardians! 🧚‍♀️✨


This is a story-driven school roleplay game where you enroll as a Fairy!

Choose Bloom or create your own OC student.
👗 Customize & dress your character with hundreds of options
🏫 Attend classes to get experience & butterflies.
⚔️ Fight creatures and complete boss battles.
🔓 Unlock Stella, Flora, Musa, Tecna, and Aisha by leveling up.

🌈 Unlock Magic Winx & Charmix on each character.
🏠 Explore the campus and roleplay with your friends.

Credits to SEPROPHIM for the loading screen
Winx Club TM & © Rainbow S.p.A. All rights reserved.
💗 Made with passion by Matt B. Creations and produced by Exclusible

llm.loop: enroll as a fairy -> attend classes for XP and butterflies -> fight creatures and bosses -> level up to unlock Winx characters and transformations
llm.objectives: level up and unlock all Winx fairies and transformations
llm.progression: XP, butterflies, characters, Magic Winx/Charmix, tiers
llm.instructions: choose Bloom or OC, customize, attend classes, fight bosses, unlock characters, roleplay on campus
